$comment: The managed label set of scantor (data, not a JSON Schema). Read by Go internal/container (ManagedLabels) and TS orchestrator/server/utils/labels.ts (managedLabels); both are unit-tested against this file. Every container and network scantor creates gets `fixed` plus `scantor.kind=<kind>` plus the identity labels of its kind; these run-time labels override image labels with the same key. Containers are recognised only by these labels AND their name prefix, never by image labels. `forbiddenImageLabelKeys` is the pattern of Dockerfile rule D9 and of the post-build label check. Test tooling labels (`scantor.test=true`, `scantor.dev=true`) are not managed labels. See docs/architecture.md §7, docs/security.md LBL-1…LBL-5, docs/tasks.md §8.2.

identityKeys.scantor.op: workspace helper operation (init, purge, list, read, write-files, delete-files, scaffold, extract, git-clone, git-pull, commit, discard, snapshot)
